text:
Maria C.: Quick q on the new response field we discussed in API review — is `billable_tokens` going to replace `usage.prompt_tokens` / `usage.completion_tokens` or be additive?
Kevin L.: Plan is additive for now. we want a single canonical field for billing but keep the old ones for backcompat for 3 months.
Alex R.: +1 on additive. need to confirm how cached tokens are reported though. billing system currently subtracts cached hits from prompt count.
Sam T.: For cached responses we currently return `cached: true` inside the per-choice object. should we surface cached token counts explicitly?
Maria C.: Example payload i had in mind:
```json
{
  "id": "resp_123",
  "usage": { "prompt_tokens": 120, "completion_tokens": 40 },
  "billable_tokens": 100, // opaque to client for now
  "choices": [{ "text": "...", "cached": true }]
}
```
Kevin L.: That looks fine but comment on `billable_tokens` as opaque - we should document how it's computed. also include `billing_breakdown` as opt-in?
Alex R.: If we expose `billing_breakdown` it should be behind `?billing=detail` query flag to avoid perf overhead. breakdown fields: `effective_prompt`, `cached_savings`, `fallback_model_cost` etc.
Jess P.: Doc note: any opt-in param must be clearly labeled beta and only for logged-in orgs. we'll need a docs PR.
Sam T.: Implementation detail: runtime already tracks kv-cache hits per request. we can compute cached_savings = raw_prompt_tokens - actual_prompt_tokens. cheap to emit when flag is set.
Kevin L.: Decision: Ship v1 with additive `billable_tokens` (single int). Keep `usage.*` until deprecation window end. Add `?billing=detail` behind feature flag that returns `billing_breakdown` object.
Maria C.: Timeline? i need to update SDKs and platform notes for tomorrow sync.
Kevin L.: Canary rollout starting Tue -> three days -> full. Deprecation notice for old fields at +3 months.
Alex R.: Heads up for reconciliations: we'll run parallel billing job that reads `billable_tokens` and compares to existing aggregator for two billing cycles. alert on >0.5% delta.
billing-bot: Reconciliation job scheduled: jobs/recon/billable_vs_usage nightly starting 2025-02-01. See https://infra.jobs/recon/2334 :white_check_mark:
Jess P.: I'll open a docs PR and add migration guide snippet + example responses. tagging @devex for SDK changes.
Sam T.: small API detail: when `cached: true` but fallback used (model fallback), cached_savings should be 0. make sure runtime sets a `cache_origin` enum (prefix|kv|none|fallback).
Maria C.: Good call. also let's add a header `X-Redwood-Billing-Version: 1` to responses during canary to make detection easier for customers.
Kevin L.: Agree. add header and also a `/v1/billing-schema` endpoint returning machine-readable schema for tooling.
Alex R.: For accounting, we need sample CSV columns: request_id, billable_tokens, raw_prompt_tokens, raw_completion_tokens, cache_origin, org_id, model. I'll add to recon ticket.
Maria C.: Action items: @Kevin L. create server PR (add field + header), @Sam T. ensure cache_origin semantics, @Jess P. docs PR, @Alex R. add recon job columns. i'll update SDKs after canary.
Kevin L.: Working on PR now, will ping for review.
Jess P.: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/987 coming in next hour.
Sam T.: PR opened for runtime: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2116 awaiting review.
Maria C.: Thanks all. ping me if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:
